page.title: Pathway Diagram View
page.introduction:
Displays in a graphical form the entities imported by the user from the Pathway Preview panel. It can be used to examine their properties, import entities into physiology and manage their linking to species and reactions in Physiology.
Pathway Diagram represents graphically objects from the Pathway Objects panel.
page.appearance:
Various physical entities and interactions are shown as circles. Select a circle to read its type (complex, small molecule, protein, or other) in the Entity Properties pane. A shortened name is drawn on the circle, and pointing at the circle shows the full name. The circle may also be filled brown, blue, or green; the properties pane is how you tell the type. The relationships between entities are shown as full lines (for biochemical reactions) or dotted lines (for catalysis and control).
Selecting a single entity activates the bottom Entity Properties pane that shows the properties of a selected entity.
page.operations:
More entities can be added from the Pathway Preview.
Selecting multiple entities activates Group button.
Selected entities can be imported into the BioModel and be either created new or linked to existing species and reactions in Physiology using Physiology Links button. The same functionality can be accessed as well by mouse right click an entity in the diagram view.
To simplify operations, the items in the diagram can be filtered in real time by typing a string inside the Search field. All the matching entities will show up in the diagram as selected (the diagram is filtered to the matching entities). They may also be marked in red.
